introspection.tableInfo: PRAGMA table_info returns visible columns and reindexes cid without generated hidden columns; compared directly with the S0.08 baseline.
introspection.tableXinfo: PRAGMA table_xinfo returns visible and hidden/generated columns with physical CIDs; recorded separately per registry table.
introspection.deliberateDistinction: xinfo hidden CIDs are not schema drift and are not compared to S0.08 table_info CIDs.

rules.registry: Exact live syncClassificationRegistry order and values; S0.09 values are compared only after mapping to canonical fields.
rules.schema: Fresh production migrations, not a copied schema fixture. table_info is compared directly with S0.08 for visible cid/type/default/pk; table_xinfo separately records hidden/generated columns and physical CIDs. SQLite intentionally reindexes table_info cid without hidden columns.
rules.primaryKey: logical declaration, production primaryKeyColumns, and raw SQLite primary key are recorded separately; known differences are facts.
rules.unique: Business unique-key text is split by production getBusinessUniqueKeys and matched against SQLite unique index column sets.
rules.triggers: Trigger lookup is database-qualified. Hashes cover exact sqlite_master SQL; event parsing uses production triggerEvent.
rules.local: LocalRuntime and BackupOnly have no incremental row capture. This does not claim they are excluded from the whole database-file backup.
rules.derived: DerivedRebuild tables have no row capture and are rebuilt from synced sources; FTS shadow tables are cataloged separately.
rules.preflight: Each negative starts from a valid production fixture and restores the exact original trigger before the next negative.
rules.remote: Unregistered RowSync targets are quarantined and not written; unknown database names fail before acknowledgement.
rules.fts: Rebuild is the exact production notes_fts migration after delete-all. Direct MATCH is tested separately from the production LIKE fallback.
rules.reviewPlans: A real vfs review_plans row is scored through ReviewPlanService/ReviewPlanRepo, collected through getPendingChanges/enrichChangesWithData, serialized through the production change codec, applied through applyDownloadedChangesToDatabases into a separate fresh vfs, and read back through ReviewPlanRepo. Unknown fields and FSRS columns stay in the row; the sync parser deliberately ignores outer unknown keys.
rules.unknownFields: The real __sync_unknown_fields vault is written for review_plans; bigint and null round-trip after an unrelated row update, and the canonical hash covers only stable field values.
rules.probes: Review-plan drift probes record observed production behavior instead of assuming every case rejects: unknown columns are vaulted and accepted, primary-key drift is business-key aliased, and a future updated_at is quarantined as clock drift.
